text.KredimGeldi bilgi güvenliği politikası:: KredimGeldi Information Security Policy: our principles for the protection of information assets and personal data.
text.Bilgi varlıklarını ve kişisel verileri k: On this page, you can find the principles we have adopted and the commitments we have made to protect information assets and personal data.
text.360Dijital olarak, kuruluşumuz yasal şar: As 360Dijital, our organization is committed to complying with legal requirements and, within the scope of our activities, to protecting confidentiality and integrity as well as all physical and electronic information assets.
text.Bilgi Güvenliği Yönetim Sistemi (BGYS) g: Information Security Management System (ISMS) requirements are carried out in alignment with ISMS objectives. In accordance with the ISO 27001:2019 ISMS Scope, our Policy includes the following:
text.Bilgi güvenliği yönetim sistemimizin ISO: Ensuring that our information security management system is documented, certified and continuously improved in accordance with the requirements of the ISO 27001:2019 standard,
text.Personelimizin BGYS farkındalığını sürek: Continuously increasing our personnel's ISMS awareness,
text.Stratejik iş planları ve BGYS hedefleri: Defining, identifying, assessing and controlling the relevant risks within the scope of risk and opportunity management, in line with strategic business plans and ISMS objectives,
text.BGYS ile ilgili tüm yasal mevzuat ve söz: Ensuring full compliance with all legal regulations and contracts relating to the ISMS,
text.BGYS varlıklarına yönelik risklerin izle: Ensuring that risks to ISMS assets are monitored and managed effectively,
text.BGYS kapsamında paydaşlarımızın bilgi va: Protecting the confidentiality of our stakeholders' information assets within the scope of the ISMS,
text.7 Nisan 2016 tarihli ve 29677 sayılı Res: Under the Personal Data Protection Law (KVKK) No. 6698 dated 24 March 2016, published in Official Gazette No. 29677 dated 7 April 2016, personal data given special importance are data relating to race, ethnic origin, religion or other beliefs, attire and clothing, criminal convictions and security measures.
text.Kuruluşumuz, KVKK ile “özel nitelikli” o: Our organization exercises a high degree of sensitivity in the lawful processing and protection of personal data designated as “special category” under KVKK. In this context, the technical and administrative measures taken are meticulously applied with respect to special categories of personal data, and regular audits are carried out.
text.Sektörümüzde bilgi güvenliği alanında ör: With the goal of being an exemplary organization in the field of information security in our sector, we are committed to continuously improving our system in line with our ISMS objectives and to ensuring sustainable information security conditions.
